title: Sales and Leases
description: Sales and Leases of Goods under UCC Articles 1 and 2, Weeks 1–8 (Sepinuck, Chapters 1–6). Covers which law governs, formation and the battle of the forms, the statute of frauds, warranties and disclaimers, gap fillers, delivery and risk of loss, remedies, the parol evidence rule, assignment and delegation, repudiation, and excuse.

Sales_and_Leases_Week10_Condensed_Outlin.title: Sales and Leases Outline
Sales_and_Leases_Week10_Condensed_Outlin.description: Condensed outline of Weeks 1–8 for the Week 10 assessment. 16 sections cover the UCC and governing law, formation and § 2-207, the statute of frauds and unconscionability, good faith and modification, express and implied warranties, quantity and price, delivery and risk of loss, disclaimers, remedies, the parol evidence rule, assignment, termination, insecurity and repudiation, and excuse, with worked problems. Case boxes mark main, note, and cited-only cases with their casebook pages and class slides.

Sales_and_Leases_Bar_Questions.html.title: Sales and Leases Bar Questions
Sales_and_Leases_Bar_Questions.html.description: 272 bar-style multiple-choice questions covering every rule, case, and assigned problem in the Weeks 1–8 outline, across 18 topics from which law governs and the battle of the forms through warranties, risk of loss, disclaimers, remedy limits, the parol evidence rule, assignment, repudiation, and excuse. Each question sets out new facts, and every answer choice has its own explanation. Variations change one fact to test whether the result changes. Filter by topic, shuffle the questions or answers, retry the ones you missed, and use the coverage map to find the questions for any outline item.

Sales_and_Leases_Practice_Exams.html.title: Sales and Leases Practice Exams
Sales_and_Leases_Practice_Exams.html.description: 19 practice exams (285 questions) for the Week 10 assessment, written in the style of Professor Richardson's sample exam: 15 stand-alone, five-choice questions each, mixing rule questions ("Which of the following is NOT…") with short hypos that ask who wins and why, plus "None of the above" and "All of the above" choices that are sometimes the answer. Each exam samples the whole Weeks 1–8 condensed outline, and together they cover all 16 sections: which law governs, formation and § 2-207, the statute of frauds, good faith and modification, express and implied warranties, title, quantity and price, delivery and acceptance, risk of loss, disclaimers, remedies, the parol evidence rule, assignment, termination, insecurity and repudiation, and excuse. Every choice has its own explanation. Study mode checks each answer as you pick it; Exam mode lets you answer a full exam and then grade it. Filter by exam or outline section, shuffle the questions, and retry the ones you missed.

Sales_and_Leases_Practice_Exams_II.html.title: Sales and Leases Practice Exams II
Sales_and_Leases_Practice_Exams_II.html.description: A second set of 14 practice exams (210 new questions) for the Week 10 assessment, in the same style as the first: Professor Richardson's sample-exam format, with 15 stand-alone, five-choice questions per exam that mix short hypos asking who wins and why with rule questions ("Which of the following is NOT…"), plus "None of the above" and "All of the above" choices that are sometimes the answer. Every fact pattern is new. The cases are tested by application, not recall: instead of asking what happened in Daitom, Casazza, Market Street, Roth Steel, Rogath, Razor, Top of Iowa, or the note cases, each question gives new facts that track the case (a pump buyer's purchase order that reserves its remedies, a lumber mill that threatens to stop shipping, a lamp buyer warned by an appraiser, an e-bike warranty sealed in the box, a farm that goes silent in an inverted market) and asks you to apply its rule. Each exam samples the whole Weeks 1–8 condensed outline, and together they cover all 16 sections and the assigned problems. Every choice has its own explanation. Study mode checks each answer as you pick it; Exam mode lets you answer a full exam and then grade it. Filter by exam or outline section, shuffle the questions, and retry the ones you missed.

Sales_and_Leases_Statutory_Supplement.ht.title: Sales and Leases Statutory Supplement
Sales_and_Leases_Statutory_Supplement.ht.description: Every UCC section the Weeks 1-8 outline and the practice sets cite (100 sections from Articles 1, 2, and 9), from Selected Commercial Statutes, 2026 edition, with the Official Comments. Section text is summarized in the statute's own key words and each comment is condensed; comments the outline or the practice questions rely on are marked. Search by word, phrase, or cite (type 2-207 to go straight there), filter by any of the 16 outline sections, follow cross-references between sections, and open or close all the comments at once.

Sales_and_Leases_Focused_Practice_Exams..title: Sales and Leases Focused Practice Exams
Sales_and_Leases_Focused_Practice_Exams..description: Four practice exams (60 new questions) on just four topics: assignment and delegation (§ 2-210), liquidated damages (§ 2-718), warranties (§§ 2-312 to 2-318), and limited remedies (§ 2-719). Each exam has 15 stand-alone, five-choice questions in Professor Richardson's sample-exam format and covers all four topics, with warranties weighted most heavily: express and implied warranties, title and infringement, disclaimers, cumulation, and privity. Every fact pattern is new, cases are tested by application rather than recall, and every choice has its own explanation. Study mode checks each answer as you pick it; Exam mode lets you answer a full exam and then grade it. Filter by exam or topic, shuffle the questions, and retry the ones you missed.
